# ContextPack

> ContextPack is a 100% free, zero-runtime-dependency CLI, Node.js library, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for packing codebases and Git diffs into token-budgeted, LLM-ready context.

- Canonical URL: https://fastpresspages.github.io/contextpack/
- GitHub: https://github.com/fastpresspages/contextpack
- License: Apache-2.0
- Runtime dependencies: 0
- Node.js requirement: >= 18.17

## Features

- Formats context into Anthropic XML (<documents><document>), Markdown, or llms-full.txt.
- Enforces strict token budgets (--max-tokens 32k, 64k, 128k).
- Integrates ASCII/Unicode directory tree and Git diffs.
- Stdio MCP server (contextpack-mcp) exposing pack_codebase, get_tree, pack_diff, and estimate_tokens.
- Composite GitHub Action for automated CI packing.

## Quick CLI Usage

- `npx -p github:fastpresspages/contextpack contextpack .`
- `npx -p github:fastpresspages/contextpack contextpack src/ -f markdown -t 32k -o prompt.md`
- `npx -p github:fastpresspages/contextpack contextpack . --tree-only`
- `npx -p github:fastpresspages/contextpack contextpack . --tokens-only`

## MCP Server Setup

Command: `npx -y -p github:fastpresspages/contextpack contextpack-mcp`

Tools:
- pack_codebase: Pack directory into token-capped context
- get_tree: Generate directory tree with sizes and token estimates
- pack_diff: Pack staged or branch Git diffs
- estimate_tokens: Fast BPE token count approximation
